reviewContext.issueReference: none; checkpoint 17ee627f + agent-gateway v0.1.11 pin 81942935; continuation session opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-854 (plan review comm-020006, STT-DESIGN-001 and STT-PLAN-854-001 resolved); original session-852 dispatch comm-019860, intake comm-019861
reviewContext.userProblem: riela/speech-to-text calls OpenAI through Riela's own HTTP client and retries every failure the same way, so quota exhaustion gets retried and the vendor problem code is never reported. Local engines need hand-written argv, and falling back to another provider takes routing nodes.
requiredOutcomes: openai/gemini/openrouter transcribe via agent-gateway (ProductionGatewayExecutor.transcribe + GatewayTranscriptionParams); key referenced by env name.

Quota exhaustion makes one vendor request and is non-retryable; 429/5xx/transport errors retry up to maxAttempts with Retry-After or exponential backoff; failures carry failureClass/httpStatus/providerProblem with no secrets.
Config-only fallback/fallbackOn chain; output records fallbackFrom.
Provider-aware .stt.json cache with cacheAcceptsFallback; legacy files are reused only for the primary.
workflow validate rejects unknown providers, bad fallback entries, bad fallbackOn, env outside the allowlist, and whisper-cpp with container/sandbox.
docs/workflows/speech.md documents everything, with whisper-cpp and openai->whisper-cpp examples.
nonGoals: No agent-gateway pin change beyond the committed v0.1.11 (c659e9f) and no Package.resolved change.
deepgram/elevenlabs/google are not moved to the gateway.
No change to TTS, Home Assistant, MediaPipelineService.send, or apple behavior.
Do not restart or reconfigure RielaApp; no real network or vendor calls in tests.
constraints: Backward compatible: existing options, defaults, command placeholders, fingerprint identity, and no-fallback output shape are unchanged.
Evidence goes only under the gitignored tmp/stt-agent-gateway/<plan>/.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Wave-1 contract plan stt-01 pins SpeechToTextProvider cases, SpeechFailureClass/SpeechProviderFailure/SpeechFailureClassifier, SpeechRetry, SpeechToTextChain/Parser, SpeechTranscriptionRequest, the SpeechTranscriptionGateway seam on BuiltinWorkflowAddonResolver, and a placeholder production closure.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The wave-2 plans (stt-02/03/05/06) build on fixed shapes and their write sets stay disjoint.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: stt-02 maps the agent-gateway v0.1.11 (c659e9f) structured GatewayTranscriptionFailure (classification, httpStatus, retryAfterSeconds, vendorErrorType/Code, redacted 16 KiB rawBody) and GatewayRPCError codes onto SpeechProviderFailure per design §2.1.1; Riela adds billing_* quota codes and Gemini PerDay QuotaFailure on top of the gateway classification; authFailed/invalidRequest/unknown are rejected and never fall back.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Design §2.1.1 (amendment 2026-11-12, session 854). The session-852 scope-amendment blocker (500-byte body truncation, dropped Retry-After) is resolved by the pin; the transport is not injectable, so request counts are stub GatewayTranscribing calls backed by the cited one-request-per-call code.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: stt-04 owns Tests/RielaCLITests/MediaPipelineMediaLogicTests.swift and depends on stt-02.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The file calls the removed transcribeChunk/MediaPipelineSTTOptions; without stt-02 the placeholder seam would make provider openai fail closed (design §8).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: The run-time whisper-cpp host-only rejection lives in BuiltinAddonContainerResolver (stt-05), because the worker receives the addon with container/sandbox stripped. It evaluates host-rendered effective options (raw command/fallback preserved) and rejects by direct provider scan before any dispatch, so templated values or parser failures cannot bypass it.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: BuiltinAddonContainerResolver.swift sets workerInput.addon.container/sandbox = nil (~lines 138-140); MediaPipelineContext.finish renders options inside the worker (MediaPipelineAddons.swift:71-93); review finding STT-DESIGN-001 (comm-019998).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: stt-04 runs in wave 3 after stt-03, because it calls whisperCppTranscribe and uses classified HTTP providers, and it deletes transcribeChunk only after the call site is gone.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps the build green between waves and keeps one owner per file within each wave.

intentionalTradeoffs: MediaPipelineSpeechProviders.swift is written by stt-01 (wave 1) and then stt-03 (wave 2); SpeechTranscriptionAgentGateway.swift by stt-01 then stt-02; MediaPipelineAddons.swift by stt-01 (one switch arm) then stt-04. All pairs are ordered by dependsOn.
Wave-2 plans share one working tree and build cache; a half-finished edit in one can break another's build, so each plan records the failure, reruns, and reports it.
Cache writes stay unconditional (as today) even with cache:false.
supportedEdgeCases: OPENAI_BASE_URL with or without a trailing /v1 is normalized as transcribeChunk did (design §2.1).

Quota exhaustion: OpenAI insufficient_quota/credit_balance_exhausted/billing_*, any HTTP 402, Gemini 429 with a PerDay QuotaFailure -> quota-exhausted, 1 vendor request, moves to the next fallback at once (§4, §5).
Retry-After honoured, else 2^(attempt-1)s, clamped 0...60s, bounded by maxAttempts and the node deadline (§4).
whisper-cpp: empty language -> -l auto; missing binary/model -> unavailable; non-zero exit -> unavailable with redacted stderr tail; timeout -> transport-error (§2.2).
Missing required env key: policyBlocked without fallback, unavailable inside a chain (§3).
Cache: legacy primary-fingerprint files still hit; a legacy entry matching only a fallback identity is a miss even with cacheAcceptsFallback (§6).
Templated ({{...}}) option values are skipped by validation; raw fallback/command and literal fallbackOn are still checked (§7).
whisper-cpp anywhere in the chain plus addon.container/addon.sandbox is rejected at validate and run time (§2.2).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Quota identifiers beyond the gateway's 16 KiB redacted rawBody (§9 R1).
Audio format conversion for whisper-cpp (inputs are whatever whisper-cli accepts).
Moving deepgram/elevenlabs/google to the gateway; TTS, Home Assistant, apple behavior changes.
Live vendor or real whisper.cpp runs in tests; Linux media container egress changes (R3).

MediaPipelineAddons.swift diff is a single switch arm; no AgentGatewayAppCore import.
Step 0 confirms the design §2.1.1 v0.1.11 citations (file:line) against .build/checkouts/agent-gateway at c659e9f.

The mapping passes every design §8 production-boundary test with a stub GatewayTranscribing throwing real GatewayTranscriptionFailure/GatewayRPCError values (quota: 1 call with httpStatus/providerProblem; 429 retryAfterSeconds 0 x maxAttempts 3 = 3 calls; Gemini stub with realistic vendorErrorCode "429"/vendorErrorType RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED -> providerProblem RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (PerDay -> quota-exhausted); OpenRouter 402 with code "402" -> quota-exhausted, no providerProblem; providerProblem = non-numeric vendorErrorCode else vendorErrorType; 503 preserved; -32011 unavailable; no key/rawBody text in messages).
Package.resolved is unchanged.
whisperCppTranscribe argv/order, auto language, unavailable/transport mapping tests pass.
deepgram/elevenlabs/google use sendClassified; quota gives 1 request; 5xx retries maxAttempts; delta-seconds Retry-After header becomes retryAfter; request shapes unchanged.
MediaPipelineService.swift and MediaPipelineService+Stages.swift are unchanged.

Validation issues for unknown provider, bad fallback entries, bad or orphaned fallbackOn, env outside the union allowlist, and whisper-cpp with container/sandbox; no issues for valid configs or for any templated rendered option (provider, model, maxAttempts, timeoutSeconds, onDevice, cacheAcceptsFallback, whisperCpp scalars), while raw fallback/command and literal fallbackOn are still checked (design §7, STT-PLAN-001).

BuiltinAddonContainerResolver runs the host-only check on EFFECTIVE options (finish-equivalent rendering via renderAddonConfig/addonVariables, raw command/fallback preserved) right after the sandbox/container guard, before image selection, isolation stripping, admission or any runner call; the decision is a direct scan of the effective provider and raw fallback providers, never gated on SpeechToTextOptionsParser success (design §2.2, STT-DESIGN-001).

Container AND sandbox regressions each throw the exact host-only policyBlocked message with zero runner/primary calls for: templated provider rendering to whisper-cpp; literal whisper-cpp with templated maxAttempts/whisperCpp.threads; openai with raw fallback [whisper-cpp]. openai-only plus container still dispatches to the video image; openai-only plus sandbox is not host-only-rejected; raw fallback command {{path}} stays unrendered.
